scope: Engineering-only, 3 frozen hosts; one sampled 8192bp window per host, both strands. No interaction labels, training, ranking or model promotion.
host_rule: First three sorted frozen hosts, fixed without outcomes
selection: For each host, first full 8192bp window among the original canonical-contig 32-window sampling. Exactly forward and reverse complement; never replace on response failure.
pooling: Mean each oriented token tensor in float64 then store float32; average the two stored orientation vectors in float64 then store float32. No full token tensors retained.
resume: Journal attempted job before POST. Reuse only verified completed jobs. An attempted job without a verified completed record blocks resume and is never automatically resubmitted. An explicit resume with unchanged protocol/code may advance only unattempted jobs.
budget_semantics: Aggregate budget covers newly downloaded successful JSON response bytes; on any network/decode/limit error stop the pilot immediately. No new job is submitted after an unresolved attempt. Limits do not bound peak process memory or absolute wall time.
limitations: One window samples a small fraction of each genome, explicitly reported. Not the 32-window representation comparison or a susceptibility model.
Hosted weights/runtime identity unknown; incompatible with local-checkpoint v1 cache.
370D has incomplete outcome labels, irrelevant to this label-free engineering pilot.
Server wait/timeouts and one failure may leave a submitted inference unresolved; no automatic polling or resend.
